transformers/models/wav2vec2/feature_extraction_wav2vec2.py:98 normalization: (x - x.mean()) / np.sqrt(x.var() + 1e-7), on the float32 array (1e-7 is a Python float, so under NEP 50 the sum stays float32)
numpy/_core/_methods.py:132 mean: np.add.reduce of the float32 samples, dtype None (float32 pairwise summation)
numpy/_core/_methods.py:142 mean: the float32 sum divided by the intp count, then cast back with ret.dtype.type
numpy/_core/_methods.py:178 var: its mean is the float32 keepdims sum, true_divide by the intp count into a float32 out
numpy/_core/_methods.py:188 var: x - mean in float32, then squared in place
numpy/_core/_methods.py:201 var: np.add.reduce of the float32 squares
numpy/_core/_methods.py:211 var: the sum of squares divided by the intp count (ddof 0), then cast back with ret.dtype.type

transformers/pipelines/audio_classification.py:215 the audio-classification pipeline calls the extractor the same way on what it is given, and passes the attention_mask on to the model; the exported LID graph takes input_values only. The 3 s window is Run 9 Decision 6, not the pipeline's
transformers/pipelines/automatic_speech_recognition.py:210 without a pyctcdecode decoder the pipeline type is "ctc" (no beam search, no LM)
transformers/pipelines/automatic_speech_recognition.py:542 greedy: argmax per frame over the vocabulary (torch.argmax returns the first index on ties, as np.argmax does)
transformers/pipelines/automatic_speech_recognition.py:619 CTC decodes with skip_special_tokens=False
transformers/pipelines/automatic_speech_recognition.py:620 the per-frame ids go to tokenizer.decode whole, uncollapsed

transformers/tokenization_utils.py:1069 ids of added tokens (<pad>, <s>, </s>, <unk>) decode to their content
transformers/models/wav2vec2/tokenization_wav2vec2.py:282 any other id decodes through the vocabulary; an id not in it becomes <unk>
transformers/models/wav2vec2/tokenization_wav2vec2.py:408 _decode groups tokens by default (the pipeline does not pass group_tokens)
transformers/models/wav2vec2/tokenization_wav2vec2.py:300 repeats merge first (itertools.groupby over the token strings)
transformers/models/wav2vec2/tokenization_wav2vec2.py:306 then the CTC blank <pad> (id 0) is dropped
transformers/models/wav2vec2/tokenization_wav2vec2.py:310 then each "|" becomes replace_word_delimiter_char (" ")
transformers/models/wav2vec2/tokenization_wav2vec2.py:341 then the tokens are joined with "" (spaces_between_special_tokens=False) and str.strip() is applied
transformers/models/wav2vec2/tokenization_wav2vec2.py:443 then clean_up_tokenization, since tokenizer_config.json sets clean_up_tokenization_spaces true

transformers/tokenization_utils_base.py:3889 clean_up_tokenization is str.replace in this order: " ." -> ".", " ?" -> "?", " !" -> "!", " ," -> ",", " ' " -> "'", " n't" -> "n't", " 'm" -> "'m", " 's" -> "'s", " 've" -> "'ve", " 're" -> "'re"
